verdict.rationale: Honeycomb Boards are documented as shareable workspaces for saving and organizing queries, SLOs and visualizations, so the dashboard-sharing core is directly supported. The pack gives no detail on the range of visualization types. Its 'Board Templates' are pre-configured starter boards, not dashboard template variables, so they earn no credit for that part of the story. missing for 10: documented rich visualization types, template/dashboard variables, independent or hands-on corroboration of Boards.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: A Board is a workspace where you can save, organize, and share analysis components focused on a common objective.
Learn how Boards work as centralized workspaces to organize queries, monitor SLOs, collaborate with teammates, and save visualizations for reuse and sharing.
